name: classification-task
description: Processing container for preprocessing nrrd images, training a classification model and running inference with a trained model

templates.description: Resample and z-score normalize nrrd images into numpy arrays

env.name: PATCH_SIZE
env.description: Target shape (as a Python tuple literal string, e.g. '(128, 128, 128)') the input volume is resampled to before normalization.

inputs.name: nrrd
inputs.description: Expects one subdirectory per case, named after the case identifier, containing a single <identifier>.nrrd file.

outputs.name: preprocessed
outputs.description: Creates for each input case a subdirectory with the same identifier containing a single <identifier>.npy file.

templates.description: Resample and z-score normalize nrrd images into numpy arrays with the patch size of the selected model

inputs.name: nrrd
inputs.description: Expects one subdirectory per case, named after the case identifier, containing a single <identifier>.nrrd file.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The selected model's config.json, provided by the model-download task. Every image is resized to the patch size in this file, which is the patch size used for training.

outputs.name: preprocessed
outputs.description: Creates for each input case a subdirectory with the same identifier containing a single <identifier>.npy file.

templates.description: Train a ResNet classification model against tags fetched from OpenSearch

env.name: TAG_TO_CLASS_MAPPING_JSON
env.description: Comma-separated list of at least two tags to classify (used to build the tag-to-class-index mapping).

env.name: DIMENSIONS
env.description: Spatial dimensionality of the input volumes, e.g. '3D' or '2D'.

env.name: MODEL_CHECKPOINT_NAME
env.description: Name of the trained model. Allowed characters are lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '_'. A UTC timestamp is appended, and the result is stored in config.json of the "model" output.

env.name: KAAPANA_PROJECT_IDENTIFIER
env.description: Identifier of the project that started the run. The workflow-api sets it for every task. It is used to look up the OpenSearch index of the project in the access-information-interface.

inputs.name: preprocessed
inputs.description: Expects one subdirectory per case, named after the case identifier, containing a single <identifier>.npy file.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: Checkpoint(s) (model-best.pth.tar and/or model-end.pth.tar), config.json, and training.log for this run. Consumed by persist-model's "model" input, which stores it in the shared /models volume and syncs it into the kaapana-backend database.

templates.description: Predict tags for preprocessed volumes and write them back to OpenSearch

env.name: TAG_POSTFIX
env.description: If 'true' (not case-sensitive), append the model name, the fold and the checkpoint kind (best or end) to the predicted tag.

env.name: KAAPANA_PROJECT_IDENTIFIER
env.description: Identifier of the project that started the run. The workflow-api sets it for every task. It is used to look up the OpenSearch index of the project in the access-information-interface.

inputs.name: preprocessed
inputs.description: Expects one subdirectory per case, named after the case identifier, containing a single <identifier>.npy file.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The selected model's config.json and single checkpoint file, provided by the model-download task.
